dialogues.speaker: Dip Yeuk
dialogues.text: Urgh... Horse stance is pure pain to maintain... C'mon, legs! Hang in there! Three more hours!

dialogues.speaker: Dip Yeuk
dialogues.text: How exhausting... but I'll grit my teeth and keep training!

dialogues.speaker: Dip Yeuk
dialogues.text: Just like Gaming says, one second on stage is the result of ten years of off-stage training.

dialogues.speaker: Dip Yeuk
dialogues.text: If I don't train hard, my punches will hit like wet noodles and I might trip over my own spear or stab myself with my sword in battle. It'll be too late for regrets then!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you one of the guards for hire here?

dialogues.speaker: Dip Yeuk
dialogues.text: Ah, right! Gotta be honest with you, I'm still new here at the Secure Transport Agency, and my kung fu still isn't up to snuff. I gotta practice, slowly improve myself...

dialogues.speaker: Dip Yeuk
dialogues.text: Oh, other than guarding transports, I'm also the drummer of the Mighty Mythical Beasts. No worries, though, Gaming's walked me through it, and I've been practicing the basics every day...

dialogues.speaker: Dip Yeuk
dialogues.text: If you've got some time to spare, you gotta come see it! We've got nothin' but 5-star reviews from everyone in town!

dialogues.speaker: Dip Yeuk
dialogues.text: Ugh, so tiring... How the heck did he manage to keep going...?
